title: Live data
summary: Screens show what is in the database now, whoever changed it.

requirements.text: A screen that shows data reloads when the tables it shows change, whether the change came from this device, from sync or from a background worker.
Writes to synced tables announce the tables they changed only when they changed a row.

history.text: Writes announce the tables they changed only when they changed a row.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: writes to device-local tables are not announced.

requirements.text: A form holding a draft (Settings) loads once when opened, so a sync never overwrites what is being typed.
